question: does this dataset supply the independent disease supervision our cohort lacks?
source_relative: data\The number of nail fold capillaries\The number of nail fold capillaries and nail fold bleedings reflects the clinical manifestations of systemic sclerosis

derivable_label.finding: with no table in the download, the only label derivable from the files is 2 control images vs 576 others. A 2-vs-576 split cannot train or validate anything.

privacy_finding: filenames embed date + what appear to be patient personal names. No name is recorded in this output. If any of this dataset is ever used, files must be re-keyed to opaque ids first, and the original names must not enter our repo, logs, or any model artifact.
verdict: CANNOT supply disease supervision. No clinical variable of any kind is present -- no subtype, antibody, mRSS or organ involvement -- and the only filename-derivable label is 2 vs 576. The clinical table exists only in the paper, so obtaining it requires contacting the authors.
the_one_thing_it_could_still_do: 19 of 35 subjects have images from more than one visit date. That permits a test-retest / repeatability estimate of an image-derived measure -- a number we cannot compute from our own cohort at all, since none of our cases has a repeat acquisition. It measures stability, NOT accuracy, and it cannot validate any field against a clinical truth.
